question: Should ClawHub standardize new skill display names at 40 characters with grandfathering for existing over-limit names?
rationale: The linked issue asked for concise titles but did not define the exact maximum or legacy behavior, and this PR chooses both policy details.

options.title: Accept 40 with repaired grandfathering
options.body: Keep this PR direction, but require the GitHub sync exact-40 repair, focused regression coverage, real behavior proof, and green merge gates before merge.

options.title: Choose a different title policy
options.body: Ask the contributor to adjust the shared constant, UI copy, sync behavior, and tests to the maintainer-approved maximum and legacy rules.

options.title: Defer the policy
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and pause or close this PR if maintainers are not ready to enforce a stored catalog display-name limit.

recommendation.title: Accept 40 with repaired grandfathering
recommendation.body: Keep this PR direction, but require the GitHub sync exact-40 repair, focused regression coverage, real behavior proof, and green merge gates before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest history match for the GitHub-backed sync and publish surfaces where the policy lands.
